intro: Bolivia has about 12 million people, and Indigenous peoples make up a large share.

chapters.title: People
text: The constitution recognises 36 official languages. Quechua and Aymara are the largest Indigenous groups. Many women wear the traditional pollera skirt and bowler hat.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Santa Cruz is the largest city; El Alto has grown fast above La Paz.

keyTerms.meaning: An Indigenous people of the Altiplano.
